thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm putting together a 'session origin attribution' playbook for metering. We still see ~0.8% unattributed tokens in the ledger. Proposal: unify header semantics across proxies and add deterministic fallback fingerprinting in the aggregator. Thoughts?
aj: Sounds necessary. Where's the current gap? proxy -> auth header lost during async handoff?
maria: Yes. Edge proxy strips X-Client-Origin when we do retry fanout. Example headers we get: ```X-Client-Origin: tenant=acme;session=abcd1234``` When we lose it, aggregator marks origin=null and credits go to fallback. That distorts per-route quota.
sam: Could we piggyback origin on session cookie / signed token instead of header? That survives retries.
claire: Product concern — can't change token shape without notifying customers. We need compatibility mode.
lee: Operationally we need two changes: 1) normalize header canonicalization at proxy layer; 2) aggregator should attempt seed-from-kv fallback (ip + client-id + short hash). Also add an alert when unattributed_rate > 0.5% for >10m.
maria: Exactly. I'm drafting fallback order: header X-Client-Origin -> X-Route-Tag -> signed-cookie -> fall back to fingerprint(ip, ua, timestamp-window). Also add TTL so fingerprints don't create long-lived credits.
aj: For the aggregator impl: pseudocode? ```if origin present use it elif signed_cookie verify and use elif fingerprint should_use_fingerprint() -> assign provisional_origin with tag provisional:true```
metering-bot: FYI: analytics shows provisional assignments cause 95% match with later reconciliations in our test span.
sam: Provisional flag is good. Also record provenance so console can show 'attributed via fingerprint (probabilistic)'.
claire: Console UX: in the route billing dashboard show a layer toggle: 'Include provisional attributions' default off. And show an explanation tooltip.
lee: Rollout plan: implement header normalization across proxies in canary region -> turn on aggregator fallback in read-only mode (store provisional but don't bill) -> run for 48h -> enable provisional billing behind feature flag per-tenant.
maria: I'll open PRs for proxy change and aggregator change. Can someone volunteer to own console copy + tooltip?
aj: I can do console copy + small UX, pinging claire for copy review.
claire: happy to review.
lee: :thumbsup: I'll schedule canary deploy for tonight at 22:00 UTC. metering-bot will monitor.
maria: Thanks. I'll post a short doc with header spec and sample traffic sniffs. Link once ready.
